method.description: Method to validate; no paid execution or target POST.

receipt.title: USDC Payment Receipt — Base

tx_hash.title: Base transaction hash
tx_hash.description: Successful native Base USDC transfer transaction. Use a log index when multiple transfers occur. Synthetic zero hash examples do not identify a payment.

pay_to.title: Alternative recipient address
pay_to.description: Alternative lookup mode: supply pay_to + exact amount + start/end, without tx_hash/log_index.

amount.title: Exact USDC amount
amount.description: Decimal USDC, max6 fractional digits; alternative recipient/window lookup only.

start.title: Window start (UTC ISO)
start.description: Alternative mode, inclusive start; past window, max90days.

end.title: Window end (UTC ISO)
end.description: Exclusive end, not future. Multiple matches fail rather than guessing.

receipt.description: Read-only native Base USDC transfer verification with payer/payee, amount, time, block, L2 confirmations, OFAC flags and signed printable receipt.

statement.title: USDC Wallet Statement Export — Base

address.title: Public Base address
address.description: 0x +40 hex digits. Native Circle USDC only, not bridged USDbC.

start.title: Start (UTC ISO, inclusive)
start.description: Past ISO8601 time. Maximum90days, half-open range.

end.title: End (UTC ISO, exclusive)
end.description: Must follow start and not be in the future. Narrow large ranges when RPC limits are reached.

statement.description: Read-only native Base USDC JSON/CSV in/out/self transfers with reconciled opening/closing and running balances, counterparties and OFAC flags.
